## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Leadership is Narrow (4/5 Technology in top performers) with Tech and Energy driving gains while most sectors are weak.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: CRM ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%). Energy follows: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +5.64%). Consumer Discretionary showing isolated strength via TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +18.23%) despite sector weakness.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -1.50%). Consumer Staples weak: MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%). Healthcare generally soft with UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -6.03%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +15.16%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +15.49%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%), RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%), BKNG CORRECTION (1W: -6.69% | 1M: +3.21%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -1.50%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer names and payments.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +23.19%), NOW (1W: +15.57%), SLB (1W: +11.30%). Major divergence present — multiple large-cap names in CORRECTION (JPM CORRECTION, V CORRECTION, MA CORRECTION, LLY CORRECTION) signal tactical uncertainty and warrant watching for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but positive on the week; top software and semis leading. AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.66%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.37%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -4.71%). Sector breadth: Technology contributing to the two positive sectors for the week.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are uneven and showing signs of fatigue; larger names in CORRECTION. JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +1.20%), V CORRECTION (1W: -0.79% | 1M: +3.81%), PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%). Sector breadth: weak overall (financials among the nine lagging sectors).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing headline-driven dispersion. PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +13.79%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -6.03%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -7.23% | 1M: +0.83%). Watch for news-driven moves amid mixed internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to select Technology and Energy leaders (CRM, NOW, SLB) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Consumer names and bifurcated Financials (PYPL, RCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak broad breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%). BEARISH: PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%), RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.28% | 1M: -15.57%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -52.97%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (week driver) — narrow leadership; Energy (positive momentum). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Consumer Staples — broad weakness and headline risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
CRM monitor follow-through above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND continuation). NVDA above-week momentum (ABOVE TREND) is a trigger for tech risk appetite. PYPL breakdown below recent support (BELOW TREND) is a trigger for payments risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+68): Everyone Loves a Winner after blowout earnings — NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) — sentiment confirmed by price. SLB (+50): Q2 outperformance — SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +21.19%) — sentiment confirmed. PLTR (+50): Analyst upgrade/attention — PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +51.45%) — price confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-50): Price-target cuts and Stripe takeover doubts — PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) — sentiment confirmed. AMZN (-45): FTC ad auction lawsuit headline — AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -4.35%) — sentiment aligning with soft price action. LOW (-45): Guidance concern — LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -1.50%) — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth (Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive). CRM, NOW, SLB showing relative strength (CRM ABOVE TREND; NOW ABOVE TREND; SLB ABOVE TREND). Key risk: multiple large-caps in CORRECTION (JPM CORRECTION; LLY CORRECTION) and PYPL negative sentiment — watch for trend breaks and confirmatory breadth.
